# Bundle Lifecycle

`startup`: disabled → disabled, or enabled → discover/validate/activate. `reload`: validates current content; checksum hits reuse immutable cache, changed checksums create a new snapshot, and failed reload preserves an already active snapshot. `deactivate`: removes the provider snapshot without deleting cache. `shutdown`: deactivates and clears process memory. Missing/invalid bundles yield `degraded`, never an exception into ordinary HADocs operation.

States are `disabled`, `inactive`, `active`, `degraded`, and `shutdown`. Diagnostics expose discovery source/status, bundle version, checksum, compatibility, validation, cache, trust and graceful-degradation reason.
